PAGE_UNREADABLE.title: Couldn't read the sheet
PAGE_UNREADABLE.hint: The image or PDF is damaged, too blurry or can't be opened. Take or scan it again more clearly and upload it.

NO_STAFF_DETECTED.title: No staff lines found
NO_STAFF_DETECTED.hint: The system didn't see any staff lines. Photograph the page up close, well lit and straight, then upload it again.

TASK_TIMEOUT.title: Processing timed out
TASK_TIMEOUT.hint: The system got no response within the allowed time. You can try again.

AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Digitizing service unavailable
AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Couldn't reach the image-processing service. Please try again in a few minutes.

CANCELLED_BY_USER.title: You cancelled the task
CANCELLED_BY_USER.hint: You can run it again on the uploaded files or upload other files.

JOB_REJECTED.title: Request rejected
JOB_REJECTED.hint: The processing service doesn't accept this data. Try uploading a different file.

ORIGINAL_FILE_MISSING.title: Original file is gone
ORIGINAL_FILE_MISSING.hint: The original file is no longer on the system, so it can't be run again. Please upload the file again.

RECOGNITION_EMPTY.title: No notes were recognized
RECOGNITION_EMPTY.hint: The system couldn't read any notes from the pages. Use a clear, straight, well-lit image or a higher-quality PDF.

MERGE_SPINE_MISMATCH.title: The pages don't match
MERGE_SPINE_MISMATCH.hint: The pages have different numbers of staves, so they can't be merged into one score. Check the order and content of the pages.

KERN_PARSE_ERROR.title: The recognition result has a syntax error
KERN_PARSE_ERROR.hint: The merged kern text can't be read. You can look at the kern text to debug it, or try again.

EXPORT_ERROR.title: Couldn't export MusicXML
EXPORT_ERROR.hint: Recognition finished but couldn't be converted to MusicXML or MIDI. You can run recognition again or use a clearer image.

MODEL_NOT_LOADED.title: The recognition model isn't ready
MODEL_NOT_LOADED.hint: The service hasn't finished loading the Transcoda model. Wait a few minutes and try again.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Something went wrong while processing
INTERNAL_ERROR.hint: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again.

GENERIC.title: Digitizing failed
GENERIC.hint: An error occurred while processing. You can try again or upload another file.

blank.title: Blank score
blank.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}

scan.howLead: Three steps from paper sheet to practice session.
scan.tipsLead: The clearer the photo, the less you have to fix.

light.title: Even light, no shadows
light.text: Shoot where light is even, and keep hand or phone shadows off the staves.

flat.title: Flat and straight
flat.text: Keep the sheet flat and the camera parallel to the paper so staff lines don't curve.

sharp.title: Sharp and large enough
sharp.text: Get close enough to read small notes and accidentals; for scanned PDFs use a high resolution.

single.title: One piece at a time
single.text: Drop pages of the same piece only; photos and MusicXML/MIDI files can't be mixed in one go.

import.tipsLead: Pick the right file type to keep the most information.

export.title: Export
export.text: From your notation software, export the score as MusicXML (.musicxml, .mxl) or MIDI.

import.title: Import
import.text: Drop the file in the box above, name it and import; no recognition from photos needed.

edit.title: Edit and practice
edit.text: Open it in the editor to fix, listen back and practice right away.

prefer.title: Prefer MusicXML
prefer.text: MusicXML keeps accidentals, lyrics and layout; MIDI mostly has just notes and timing.

export.title: Export from notation software
export.text: Common notation programs offer MusicXML in their save or export menu.

batch.title: Import many at once
batch.text: Pick up to {count} files per round; any that fail are reported individually to retry.

scan.title: Only have paper?
scan.text: Use the digitize button at the top to photograph or upload a PDF instead.
